losses.interval: sum squared violations of point +/- 0.25 eV

protocol.primary_metric: Mean absolute deviation from requested point, per property and average; surrogate, not DFT error.

baseline_protocol.scope: Fixed historical 34-candidate cohort, not new conditional generation. Unequal call budgets, shared GPU; no speedup claim.

protocol.scope: Frozen interval-generated/selected historical cohort. Tests geometry guidance objective, not point-conditioned generator training. GPU shared; budgets are caps, not equal compute.

target_support.scope: Target neighborhood counts in the fixed 8192 property-training graphs, not the exact 8188 encodable generator set; no held-out labels used.
target_support.selection_note: Targets selected from existing official 8192-label statistics before the experiment; the frozen historical Oracle was subsequently verified as the 4096 model. Both support counts are retained; no target was changed after observing results.
